projects.name: Monitorscape
facts: Built regulatory monitoring ingestion pipelines
Collected from government portals, RSS feeds, public APIs, PDFs and dynamic web sources

projects.name: Pastelocity
facts: Designed and deployed a commerce operations platform for a retail client
Translated the owner's operational requirements into system workflows, data models and administrative interfaces
Built a three-service architecture consisting of a Next.js storefront and admin system, a Go booking service and a Go payment service
Unified product management, order capture, inventory reservation, payment verification, fulfilment and invoice delivery
Implemented reservation-based inventory control with auditable stock changes
Implemented payment-proof submission, administrative review and controlled order-status transitions
Built transactional email processing with deduplication, retries and failure recovery
Implemented automated invoice generation and delivery
Owned delivery from requirements and system design through implementation, deployment and stakeholder handoff
The client reported that the system made daily order handling noticeably faster
projects.positioning: Treat as a deployed client business system demonstrating multi-service engineering, operational workflow design and end-to-end ownership—not simply an online store.
projects.preferredDescription: Designed and deployed a multi-service commerce operations platform for a retail client, unifying product, order, inventory, payment, fulfilment and invoicing workflows.
constraints: Do not headline the current low-volume usage counts
Do not claim a measured amount of time saved
Describe the client's efficiency improvement qualitatively unless formally measured
